scope: Supplementary correctness diagnosis; not timing or the exhausted prior 32-slot admission gate
trace_observer: Read-only copies and diagnostic printf; compare full output bytes with the retained uninstrumented native/reuse failure; not performance evidence
invariants: formal duplicate-occurrence input and queries unchanged
no relaxed membership or numeric gate
no parameter search or replacement algorithm
native, reuse, safety and semantic repairs have distinct identities
stop: No automatic failed/slow process replacement. Record every attempt before launch. Stop the affected qualification branch on failure.
supplemental_timing: Conditional only after task-specific bounded, sanitizer and two-target-snapshot qualification; separately register at most 24 fresh GPU_TREE/P processes
sustained: Separate conditional registration; no automatic 10K launch
